author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: the water was a flat ground bar and the figure was a short broken stroke far from its head, so the scene lost the reference's sea and reclining pose. After: an umbrella with a tilted pole planted in a Lucide-style wave line, and an r4 head 8 above a neck stub with the reference's zigzag body (propping arm, hip, raised knee, foot) clear of the wave crests; reads as sunbathing by the sea at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Canopy drawn as a round dome rather than the reference's flatter shade to keep the head 8 clear.
